types.Tool(name='lazyown_llm_ask', description='Ask a satellite language model (Groq or local deepseek-r1:1.5b) to reason about a goal using LazyOwn tools.

Groq backend — llama-3.3-70b with native tool calling: run_command, read_nmap, read_plan, read_facts, read_objectives.
Ollama backend — deepseek-r1:1.5b via ReAct loop (Thought/Action/Observation). No API key needed; runs fully offline.

Use this when you need a satellite model to:
  • Analyse an nmap scan and suggest next steps
  • Interpret tool output and extract credentials/findings
  • Generate a specific exploit or command sequence
  • Reason about facts/objectives before injecting a new goal', inputSchema={'type': 'object', 'properties': {'goal': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'Goal or question for the satellite model.'}, 'context': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'Optional extra context (paste tool output, facts, etc.).', 'default': ''}, 'backend': {'type': 'string', 'description': "'groq' (cloud, tool calling) or 'ollama' (local deepseek-r1, ReAct).", 'enum': ['groq', 'ollama'], 'default': 'groq'}, 'model': {'type': 'string', 'description': "Override model name (e.g. 'llama-3.1-8b-instant' for groq, 'deepseek-r1:1.5b' for ollama).", 'default': ''}, 'max_iterations': {'type': 'integer', 'description': 'Max tool-call cycles (default 6).', 'default': 6}, 'system_prompt': {'type': 'string', 'description': 'Optional system prompt override.', 'default': ''}}, 'required': ['goal']})
